body:
Greg's rules, 2026-11-06 about 05:26–05:31Z, relayed by Engram::Asistant (Engram #350/#352/#356, TermAl mailbox 588693a8 #495 and #497), verbatim:
- «Dlaczego agent mailby odpalac inne repozytorium.»
- «Mozemt utworzyc remote sesje questiki czy phoenixa. Nie chce aby agent odpalal cos cross z innego repo.»
- «po to mamy remote sesje aby z nich korzystac nie chce odpalania jakys testow na dziko, jak robil to zespol przez SSH».

Rules:
(1) A test in project X is run only by a registered TermAl session OF PROJECT X, on the right host, in its own worktree, the ordinary way: its declared command from termal-tests.toml. TermAl associates it with the session, project, workdir and store automatically.
(2) No agent runs another repository's tooling (for example TermAl's launcher by path with --root). Any root parameter is internal to TermAl.
(3) No SSH or ad-hoc remote test runs, and no cross-project runs.
(4) Missing project sessions on a remote host are created by the supported route, the same API the UI uses.
(5) Greg wants concrete run ids and results, not plans.
